questions.q: Which type of memory is volatile and holds the programs currently in use?
questions.why: RAM loses its contents when the power is off and holds programs and data in use.

questions.q: Which storage type uses a laser and pits and lands to store data?
questions.why: Optical discs have pits and lands that reflect laser light differently, read as 1s and 0s.

questions.q: Which is a valid IPv4 address?
questions.why: IPv4 has four numbers, each from 0 to 255, separated by dots.

questions.q: State two differences between a MAC address and an IP address.
questions.model: A MAC address is set by the manufacturer and does not change, but an IP address is allocated by the network and can change. A MAC address is 48 bits in hex; an IPv4 address is 32 bits.
points: MAC set by manufacturer and fixed; IP allocated by network and can change
